sections.description: Adds to GWND Fulfillment: more page styles and the full style builder (export/import, custom CSS), packing slip styles, photos, a thank-you message and a QR code on slips, and 4×6 and bulk packing slips.
sections.changelog:
1.3.2

Added

  • Five more packing slip styles, for ten in all:
  • Boutique: serif type, a centred header, double rules and round quantity badges.
  • Receipt: monospaced, with dashed lines.
  • Bold: a black header band, big uppercase order number and heavy rules. It uses the light logo from the Look tab when there is one.
  • Thermal: pure black and white, with no greys, tints or photos, for thermal label printers.
  • Ledger: full grid lines, like a pick sheet.
  • All work on Letter and 4×6.

Changed

  • Warehouse is slightly tighter, so a short order fits on one Letter page with the thank-you box.
  • Receipt's footer has no rule above it (the footer now sits in the page's bottom strip, from GWND Fulfillment 1.3.1).

1.3.1

Fixed

  • Packing slips settings: the preview buttons now show the slip style picked in the dropdown straight away. Before, they only showed the saved style, so switching the dropdown seemed to do nothing until you saved.

1.3.0

Packing slip styles, and the slip extras the free plugin no longer has. Needs GWND Fulfillment 1.3.0+ for these (on older versions the free slip still draws its own extras).

Added

  • Slip style on Fulfillment → Packing slips: Classic, Branded (brand colour and logo from the Look tab, light logo on dark brands), Minimal, Warehouse (big, high-contrast, for picking) and Compact (more items per page). Works on Letter and 4×6.
  • Product photos, the thank-you message and the QR code (with custom link and caption), moved here from the free plugin. Settings already saved carry over.
  • assets/qrcode.js and assets/css/slips-pro.css.

1.2.1

Credited to Great White North Design, always.

Removed

  • The Branding tab (menu name, plugin name and author, credit line on/off, support note). GWND Fulfillment 1.2.2+ always shows the Great White North Design credit, naming Pro when it's active. Updating deletes any branding a store had saved (gwnfp_brand).

Changed

  • Plugin URI is now https://greatwhitenorthdesign.ca/tools/fulfillment/.
  • Docs say plainly: no ShipStation or other shipping-platform integration. The 1.2.0 cleanup that deletes old ShipStation and live-tracking settings stays.

1.2.0

First release of the Pro add-on.

Added

  • Styles Poster, Split, Banner, Receipt and Route, the style builder, custom CSS, and style export/import.
  • 4×6 packing slips and bulk printing; Branding tab for white-label.
  • Live tracking and ShipStation capture are not included for now: customers get a link to the carrier's own tracking page. Updating from a test build stops the old poller and deletes those saved settings (including carrier keys).
  • Signed updates for this add-on and, until it's on WordPress.org, for GWND Fulfillment.
